description:
A music player that respects what's yours.

Noctis is a desktop music player for your local library — fast browsing,
synced lyrics, metadata editing, EQ, and more.
Discord
Download
Pick your platform from the Assets below:
──────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Platform          │Files
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Windows           │Noctis-v1.5.5-Setup.exe (installer) · Noctis-windows-x64.zip (portable)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
macOS             │Noctis-osx-arm64.dmg (Apple Silicon) · Noctis-osx-x64.dmg (Intel)
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Linux             │Noctis-x86_64.AppImage · Noctis-linux-x64.tar.gz · Noctis-linux-arm64.tar.gz
──────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Self-hosted server│noctis-server-linux-x64.tar.gz · noctis-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz (see docs/SELF-HOSTING.md)
──────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
> Running on macOS — the app isn't code-signed, so Gatekeeper quarantines it on first launch. After dragging Noctis into your Applications folder, clear the flag once in Terminal:
>
> xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Noctis.app
>
> Then open Noctis normally.
What's Changed
Fixed
- Fixed mini player menu doing nothing on Windows
- Fixed Volume tooltip covering the volume slider
- Fixed in-app downloads failing halfway
- Fixed white title bar on Windows 10
- Fixed clicks when seeking
- Fixed clicks on pause/resume
- Fixed clicks at track junctions and crossfades
- Fixed audio going silent after speed or pitch changes
- Fixed volume blip and low quality after switching devices
- Fixed Exclusive Mode hard cuts on seek and stop
- Fixed pause being treated as a disk stall
- Fixed audio stalls from memory cleanup during playback
- Fixed ReplayGain for APE/WMA files
- Fixed audio blocking laptop sleep while paused
- Fixed timeline slider desync on restore
- Fixed Stop After Current being ignored with gapless or AutoMix
- Fixed pause and seek being lost while a track loads
- Fixed restored mute still playing audio
- Fixed deleting a paused track starting the next one
- Fixed Repeat All ignoring shuffle on second pass
- Fixed timeline freezing above 1× speed
- Fixed one playback error wiping the queue
- Fixed short tracks being skipped after gapless changes
- Fixed MPRIS shuffle not shuffling
- Fixed right-click actions hitting the wrong selection
- Fixed Move to Recycle Bin permanently deleting on some drives
- Fixed rename by pattern losing play counts and favorites
- Fixed Organize Files playlist changes being overwritten
- Fixed failed cover saves reported as saved
- Fixed smart playlists showing in Add to Playlist
- Fixed playlist page keeping previous selection
- Fixed Lyrics Studio overwriting .lrc files
- Fixed Reset Settings missing many settings
- Fixed queue Select All and Delete freezing
- Fixed album page closing itself during rescan
- Fixed lists jumping to top on library reload
- Fixed timers left running after panels close
- Fixed Ctrl+A and Esc not reaching the queue panel
- Fixed arrow shortcuts skipping tracks while typing
- Fixed Space pausing instead of stamping in LRC editor
- Fixed server HTTPS on Windows
- Fixed server login throttle locking everyone out
- Fixed server downloads for non-ASCII file names
- Fixed crafted lyrics and content packs freezing the app
- Fixed plugins turning on after a settings reset
- Fixed macOS Apple Silicon build shipping Intel ffmpeg
- Fixed macOS Open With and double-click on audio files
- Fixed macOS Dock click not restoring the window
- Fixed Linux libvlc not loading on tarball builds
- Fixed Linux freezes with big libraries and folder watching
- Fixed Linux covers with capital letters not being found
- Fixed Linux dialogs and tray issues after sleep
- Fixed Linux window going see-through after sleep
- Fixed Linux AppImage cutout after long pause
- Fixed server not shutting down gracefully
- Fixed update downloads dying on slow connections
Added
- Added Tint Whole Page setting for album page
- Added resumable downloads with retry
- Added drag to reorder playlist groups
- Added Music video audio setting
- Added Update automatically toggle with Postpone
Improved
- Improved album page layout
- Improved performance by moving heavy work off the UI thread
- Improved tool dialog list performance
- Improved log redaction
- Improved crash diagnostics on Linux
Dependencies
- Updated Avalonia to 12.1.3
- Updated LibVLCSharp to 3.10.1
- Updated Microsoft.Data.Sqlite to 8.0.31
- Updated SQLitePCLRaw to 2.1.13
- Updated QrCodeGenerator to 3.2.1
- Updated Tmds.DBus.Protocol to 0.95.1
Full Changelog: v1.5.4...v1.5.5
